meta.name: firecrawl
meta.description: Search, scrape, and interact with the web via the Firecrawl CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up online, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, get data from a website, crawl documentation, download a site, or interact with pages that need clicks or logins. Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", or reference external websites. This provides real-time web search with full page content and interact capabilities — beyond what Claude can do natively with built-in tools. Do NOT trigger for local file operations, git commands, deployments, or code editing tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索、抓取并交互网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网页获取结构化数据或进行实时搜索。
copy.tagline_en: Search, scrape, and interact with web content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract structured data from websites or perform real-time web searches.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能通过 Firecrawl 在真实网页上搜索、抓取全文，还能点击、填表、登录等交互，并把网页转成干净的 Markdown 文本给你。也可爬整个站点或监控页面变化。
howto.when: 当你想搜索网页、找文章或研究话题，抓取某个网址的内容，或与需要点击、登录的页面交互时触发。你说“fetch this page”这类话也会触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下‘大模型最新进展’，要带全文摘要
say.note: 会执行 firecrawl search，返回网页内容

say.text: 抓取 https://example.com 的正文内容
盯着这个商品页面，价格变了就提醒我

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search the live web, scrape full page content, and interact with pages (clicks, forms, login) via Firecrawl, returning clean Markdown. It can also crawl a whole site or monitor pages for changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, scrape a URL, or interact with pages needing clicks or logins, such as saying 'fetch this page'.

say_en.text: Search for the latest AI news with full-page summaries.
Watch this product page and alert me if the price changes.
say_en.note: Creates a monitor for recurring checks.
